s0101.literal: Famine victims in Dongchang and Bazhou were relieved.
s0101.idiomatic: Famine victims in Dongchang and Bazhou were relieved.

s0102.literal: Songjiang Prefecture's Shanghai County suffered flooding, yet drought persisted.
s0102.idiomatic: Songjiang Prefecture's Shanghai County suffered flooding, yet drought persisted.

s0103.literal: Fifth month, on jisi day Princess Suge Bala was made Grand Princess of Zhao State.
s0103.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jisi day Princess Suge Bala was made Grand Princess of Zhao State.

s0104.literal: Rent was remitted for disaster-stricken people of De'an Prefecture, and the Hutuo River embankment was repaired.
s0104.idiomatic: Rent was remitted for disaster-stricken people of De'an Prefecture, and the Hutuo River embankment was repaired.

s0105.literal: Zhangde Prefecture suffered famine; wine-brewing was forbidden.
s0105.idiomatic: Zhangde Prefecture suffered famine; wine-brewing was forbidden.

s0106.literal: On gengwu day the people of Taifu and Linyi counties plotted rebellion; their ringleader Wang Lü'er was executed, and the rest were beaten and exiled.
s0106.idiomatic: On gengwu day the people of Taifu and Linyi counties plotted rebellion; their ringleader Wang Lü'er was executed, and the rest were beaten and exiled.

s0107.literal: Suizhou and Xuchou prefectures suffered flood and drought last year; their rent was remitted.
s0107.idiomatic: Suizhou and Xuchou prefectures suffered flood and drought last year; their rent was remitted.

s0108.literal: On xinwei day Imperial Son-in-law Tuotuo died; he was granted 50,000 strings of notes.
s0108.idiomatic: On xinwei day Imperial Son-in-law Tuotuo died; he was granted 50,000 strings of notes.

s0109.literal: On bingzi day Mars withdrew and transgressed East Saltern.
s0109.idiomatic: On bingzi day Mars withdrew and transgressed East Saltern.

s0110.literal: On gengchen day famine in Gu'an Prefecture was relieved.
s0110.idiomatic: On gengchen day famine in Gu'an Prefecture was relieved.

s0111.literal: A camp was established at Yongping to collect and support Mongol children; envoys were dispatched to announce this throughout the realm, and those who concealed them were punished.
s0111.idiomatic: A camp was established at Yongping to collect and support Mongol children; envoys were dispatched to announce this throughout the realm, and those who concealed them were punished.

s0112.literal: On guiwei day Censor-in-Chief Tuotuo was made Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief.
s0112.idiomatic: On guiwei day Censor-in-Chief Tuotuo was made Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief.

s0113.literal: The Zongren Mongol Personal Guard Army Commanderate was established.
s0113.idiomatic: The Zongren Mongol Personal Guard Army Commanderate was established.

s0114.literal: On jiashen day the imperial carriage visited Mount Wutai.
s0114.idiomatic: On jiashen day the imperial carriage visited Mount Wutai.

s0115.literal: Famine in Xiajin and Yongqing counties was relieved.
s0115.idiomatic: Famine in Xiajin and Yongqing counties was relieved.

s0117.literal: On yiyou day Baizhu was put in charge of the Zongren Mongol Personal Guard Army Commanderate, wearing a three-pearl tiger tally.
s0117.idiomatic: On yiyou day Baizhu was put in charge of the Zongren Mongol Personal Guard Army Commanderate, wearing a three-pearl tiger tally.

s0118.literal: The capital suffered famine; 200,000 shi of grain were released for relief sale.
s0118.idiomatic: The capital suffered famine; 200,000 shi of grain were released for relief sale.

s0119.literal: Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillors Dashitemuer and Duo'erzhi were beaten and dismissed from office for corruption.
s0119.idiomatic: Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillors Dashitemuer and Duo'erzhi were beaten and dismissed from office for corruption.

s0120.literal: On wuzi day the people were forbidden to gather in crowds to pray to spirits.
s0120.idiomatic: On wuzi day the people were forbidden to gather in crowds to pray to spirits.

s0121.literal: On gengyin day Henan, Shaanxi, Hejian, Baoding, Zhangde, and other routes suffered famine; grain was issued in relief, and regular levies were still reduced by half.
s0121.idiomatic: On gengyin day Henan, Shaanxi, Hejian, Baoding, Zhangde, and other routes suffered famine; grain was issued in relief, and regular levies were still reduced by half.

s0122.literal: Two thousand Han troops from the various guards were mobilized to serve as Zongren Guard garrison-farm soldiers.
s0122.idiomatic: 2,000 Han troops from the various guards were mobilized to serve as Zongren Guard garrison-farm soldiers.

s0123.literal: A comet was observed at Mount Wutai.
s0123.idiomatic: A comet was observed at Mount Wutai.

s0124.literal: On jiawu day famine in Gongchang and Jie Prefecture was relieved.
s0124.idiomatic: On jiawu day famine in Gongchang and Jie Prefecture was relieved.

s0125.literal: On bingshen day Wu Quanjie was made patriarch of the Extended Teaching and specially advanced upper minister.
s0125.idiomatic: On bingshen day Wu Quanjie was made patriarch of the Extended Teaching and specially advanced upper minister.

s0126.literal: Intercalary month, on wuxu day Chancellor Zhuge Liang the Loyal and Martial Marquis was enfeoffed as Prince of Majestic Valor, Loyal Martiality, Manifest Spirit, and Benevolent Succor.
s0126.idiomatic: Intercalary month, on wuxu day Chancellor Zhuge Liang the Loyal and Martial Marquis was enfeoffed as Prince of Majestic Valor, Loyal Martiality, Manifest Spirit, and Benevolent Succor.

s0127.literal: On xinchou day ten-thousand-household commander Li Ying took a commoner as a slave and on his own authority tattooed his face; he was punished for the offense.
s0127.idiomatic: On xinchou day ten-thousand-household commander Li Ying took a commoner as a slave and on his own authority tattooed his face; he was punished for the offense.

s0128.literal: On guimao day White Lotus Buddhist rites were forbidden.
s0128.idiomatic: On guimao day White Lotus Buddhist rites were forbidden.

s0129.literal: Suixian's Haoshe garrison suffered great flooding and famine; relief was granted.
s0129.idiomatic: Suixian's Haoshe garrison suffered great flooding and famine; relief was granted.

s0130.literal: Princes Ama and Chengtong, for unauthorized transfer of Prince Tielienie's guard soldiers, were both beaten and exiled to Hainan.
s0130.idiomatic: Princes Ama and Chengtong, for unauthorized transfer of Prince Tielienie's guard soldiers, were both beaten and exiled to Hainan.

s0131.literal: On jiachen day censorate officials requested dismissal of surveillance censors unfit for their posts, to serve as warning and encouragement; this was approved.
s0131.idiomatic: On jiachen day censorate officials requested dismissal of surveillance censors unfit for their posts, to serve as warning and encouragement; this was approved.

s0132.literal: On bingwu day impoverished northern frontier garrison soldiers were granted 32,500,000 strings of notes and 500,000 bolts of silk.
s0132.idiomatic: On bingwu day impoverished northern frontier garrison soldiers were granted 32,500,000 strings of notes and 500,000 bolts of silk.

s0133.literal: On wushen day Meixian of Fengyuan Route and Cheng Prefecture suffered famine; both were relieved.
s0133.idiomatic: On wushen day Meixian of Fengyuan Route and Cheng Prefecture suffered famine; both were relieved.

s0134.literal: Temüder's son, privy council vice director Bandan, was made privy council director.
s0134.idiomatic: Temüder's son, privy council vice director Bandan, was made privy council director.

s0135.literal: On jiyou day Yebugan Batuer, for meritorious service on the frontier, was granted gold and notes.
s0135.idiomatic: On jiyou day Yebugan Batuer, for meritorious service on the frontier, was granted gold and notes.

s0136.literal: On renzi day the Zitan Hall was constructed.
s0136.idiomatic: On renzi day the Zitan Hall was constructed.

s0137.literal: On yimao day, because Huai'an Route suffered great flooding last year, Liaoyang Route had frost that killed the crops, and Nankang Route suffered drought, rent was remitted in all cases.
s0137.idiomatic: On yimao day, because Huai'an Route suffered great flooding last year, Liaoyang Route had frost that killed the crops, and Nankang Route suffered drought, rent was remitted in all cases.

s0138.literal: On renxu day prolonged rain in Anfeng's subordinate counties damaged the crops; rent was remitted.
s0138.idiomatic: On renxu day prolonged rain in Anfeng's subordinate counties damaged the crops; rent was remitted.

s0139.literal: Baocheng County of Xingyuan suffered famine; relief was granted.
s0139.idiomatic: Baocheng County of Xingyuan suffered famine; relief was granted.

s0140.literal: On jiazi day Zhending and Shandong routes suffered famine; prohibitions on river and lake fisheries were relaxed.
s0140.idiomatic: On jiazi day Zhending and Shandong routes suffered famine; prohibitions on river and lake fisheries were relaxed.

s0141.literal: On bingyin day cave barbarians of Yuanling County, Chen Prefecture, became bandits; troops were dispatched to capture them.
s0141.idiomatic: On bingyin day cave barbarians of Yuanling County, Chen Prefecture, became bandits; troops were dispatched to capture them.

s0142.literal: An edict stated: "Those already appointed who fail to take up their posts shall be stripped of office.
s0142.idiomatic: An edict stated, "Those already appointed who fail to take up their posts shall be stripped of office.

s0143.literal: " Princess Suge Bala's wet nurse was enfeoffed Lady of Shun State.
s0143.idiomatic: " Princess Suge Bala's wet nurse was enfeoffed Lady of Shun State.

s0144.literal: Sixth month, on dingmao new moon, the imperial carriage reached Mount Wutai; the escort and palace guard were forbidden to trample the people's grain.
s0144.idiomatic: Sixth month, on dingmao new moon, the imperial carriage reached Mount Wutai; the escort and palace guard were forbidden to trample the people's grain.

s0145.literal: One investigating official each was appointed in Zhongqing and Dali routes.
s0145.idiomatic: One investigating official each was appointed in Zhongqing and Dali routes.

s0146.literal: On wuchen day subordinate counties of Yang Prefecture suffered drought; rent was remitted.
s0146.idiomatic: On wuchen day subordinate counties of Yang Prefecture suffered drought; rent was remitted.

s0147.literal: On jisi day Miangu and Zhaohua counties of Guangyuan Route suffered famine; government grain was purchased at market price to relieve them.
s0147.idiomatic: On jisi day Miangu and Zhaohua counties of Guangyuan Route suffered famine; government grain was purchased at market price to relieve them.

s0148.literal: On renshen day Mars transgressed Heart.
s0148.idiomatic: On renshen day Mars transgressed Heart.

s0149.literal: On guiyou day prohibition was reiterated against day-selectors recklessly discussing celestial signs.
s0149.idiomatic: On guiyou day prohibition was reiterated against day-selectors recklessly discussing celestial signs.

s0150.literal: On jiaxu day Xinping and Shangcai counties suffered flooding; rent was remitted.
s0150.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xinping and Shangcai counties suffered flooding; rent was remitted.

s0151.literal: On bingzi day the Hun River embankment was repaired.
s0151.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Hun River embankment was repaired.

s0152.literal: On renwu day the Chen Prefecture river overflowed, destroying the people's dwellings.
s0152.idiomatic: On renwu day the Chen Prefecture river overflowed, destroying the people's dwellings.

s0153.literal: On dinghai day subordinate counties of Fengyuan suffered flooding, and subordinate counties of Huai'an suffered drought; rent was remitted in both cases.
s0153.idiomatic: On dinghai day subordinate counties of Fengyuan suffered flooding, and subordinate counties of Huai'an suffered drought; rent was remitted in both cases.

s0154.literal: On gengyin day Sizhou suffered wind and hail, and Jiande Route suffered flooding; all were relieved.
s0154.idiomatic: On gengyin day Sizhou suffered wind and hail, and Jiande Route suffered flooding; all were relieved.

s0155.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuxu day Huai'an Route suffered flooding and the people were famine-stricken; rent was remitted.
s0155.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on wuxu day Huai'an Route suffered flooding and the people were famine-stricken; rent was remitted.

s0156.literal: On jihai day Mars transgressed Celestial River.
s0156.idiomatic: On jihai day Mars transgressed Celestial River.

s0157.literal: On dingwei day Baizhu was granted 10,000 mu of fields in Pingjiang.
s0157.idiomatic: On dingwei day Baizhu was granted 10,000 mu of fields in Pingjiang.

s0158.literal: On renzi day Prince Chachatu was dispatched to command troops on the northern frontier; he was granted 250 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, and 500,000 strings of notes.
s0158.idiomatic: On renzi day Prince Chachatu was dispatched to command troops on the northern frontier; he was granted 250 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, and 500,000 strings of notes.

s0159.literal: On wuwu day the moon transgressed the halberd star of the Well lodge.
s0159.idiomatic: On wuwu day the moon transgressed the halberd star of the Well lodge.

s0160.literal: When the imperial carriage halted at Ying Prefecture, a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners of Jincheng County.
s0160.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage halted at Ying Prefecture, a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners of Jincheng County.

s0161.literal: On gengshen day Jing Prefecture was promoted to a route.
s0161.idiomatic: On gengshen day Jing Prefecture was promoted to a route.

s0162.literal: On xinyou day the imperial carriage halted at Zeyuan Prefecture.
s0162.idiomatic: On xinyou day the imperial carriage halted at Zeyuan Prefecture.

s0163.literal: Central secretariat left associate administrator Zhang Siming, convicted of an offense, was beaten and dismissed from office, and his household was registered.
s0163.idiomatic: Central secretariat left associate administrator Zhang Siming, convicted of an offense, was beaten and dismissed from office, and his household was registered.

s0164.literal: On jiazi day one thousand sick corvée soldiers and artisans of the capital were recorded; each was granted notes and sent home.
s0164.idiomatic: On jiazi day 1,000 sick corvée soldiers and artisans of the capital were recorded; each was granted notes and sent home.

s0165.literal: Nankang Route suffered great flooding, and Lu'an County of Luz Prefecture had heavy rain; water surged to several feet deep on level ground; the people were famine-stricken; officials were ordered to grant one month's relief grain.
s0165.idiomatic: Nankang Route suffered great flooding, and Lu'an County of Luz Prefecture had heavy rain; water surged to several feet deep on level ground; the people were famine-stricken; officials were ordered to grant 1 month's relief grain.

s0166.literal: Eighth month, on wuchen day sacrifice was offered to the altars of soil and grain.
s0166.idiomatic: Eighth month, on wuchen day sacrifice was offered to the altars of soil and grain.

s0167.literal: On jisi day the people of Ningyuan County, Daozhou, led by Fu Yizhen, rebelled; officials were dispatched to suppress and capture them.
s0167.idiomatic: On jisi day the people of Ningyuan County, Daozhou, led by Fu Yizhen, rebelled; officials were dispatched to suppress and capture them.

s0168.literal: On renshen day the people of Yu Prefecture presented auspicious grain.
s0168.idiomatic: On renshen day the people of Yu Prefecture presented auspicious grain.

s0169.literal: On jiaxu day the imperial carriage halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.
s0169.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the imperial carriage halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.

s0170.literal: The Zongren Guard camp was constructed.
s0170.idiomatic: The Zongren Guard camp was constructed.

s0171.literal: Travel grain was granted to displaced persons of Luz Prefecture returning to their occupations.
s0171.idiomatic: Travel grain was granted to displaced persons of Luz Prefecture returning to their occupations.

s0172.literal: On wuyin day an edict ordered the Silkworm and Wheat Diagram painted on the walls of Deer Peak Hall, to be viewed in season and thereby know the people's affairs.
s0172.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict ordered the Silkworm and Wheat Diagram painted on the walls of Deer Peak Hall, to be viewed in season and thereby know the people's affairs.

s0173.literal: On jimao day Lu'an and Shucheng counties of Luz Route suffered flooding; relief was granted.
s0173.idiomatic: On jimao day Lu'an and Shucheng counties of Luz Route suffered flooding; relief was granted.

s0174.literal: On gengchen day seven thousand corvée soldiers for Shou'an Mountain Temple were added.
s0174.idiomatic: On gengchen day 7,000 corvée soldiers for Shou'an Mountain Temple were added.

s0175.literal: On gengyin day Temüder died; orders were issued to pay fair price and purchase his burial ground.
s0175.idiomatic: On gengyin day Temüder died; orders were issued to pay fair price and purchase his burial ground.

s0176.literal: On jiawu day Gao'an County of Ruizhou suffered famine; officials were ordered to relieve it.
s0176.idiomatic: On jiawu day Gao'an County of Ruizhou suffered famine; officials were ordered to relieve it.

s0177.literal: Ninth month, on wuxu day flooding at relay stations in Daning Route and Shuidada damaged the crops; relief was granted.
s0177.idiomatic: Ninth month, on wuxu day flooding at relay stations in Daning Route and Shuidada damaged the crops; relief was granted.

s0178.literal: Notes totaling 7,500,000 strings were granted to impoverished Mongol children.
s0178.idiomatic: Notes totaling 7,500,000 strings were granted to impoverished Mongol children.

s0179.literal: On wushen day notes were granted to soldiers and artisans who died building the temple at Shou'an Mountain — 150 strings per person.
s0179.idiomatic: On wushen day notes were granted to soldiers and artisans who died building the temple at Shou'an Mountain — 150 strings per person.

s0180.literal: On gengxu day prohibition was reiterated against pawning and hiring out wives and concubines in Jiangnan.
s0180.idiomatic: On gengxu day prohibition was reiterated against pawning and hiring out wives and concubines in Jiangnan.

s0181.literal: On xinhai day the Emperor visited Shou'an Mountain Temple and granted notes to supervising officials — 5,000 strings per person.
s0181.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Emperor visited Shou'an Mountain Temple and granted notes to supervising officials — 5,000 strings per person.

s0182.literal: On jiayin day famine in Taixing and other counties east of the Huai was relieved.
s0182.idiomatic: On jiayin day famine in Taixing and other counties east of the Huai was relieved.

s0183.literal: On bingchen day the Grand Empress Dowager died.
s0183.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Grand Empress Dowager died.

s0184.literal: On wuwu day notes totaling 1,500,000 strings were granted to Mongol children.
s0184.idiomatic: On wuwu day notes totaling 1,500,000 strings were granted to Mongol children.

s0185.literal: On jiwei day the moon transgressed Mingtang.
s0185.idiomatic: On jiwei day the moon transgressed Mingtang.

s0186.literal: On gengshen day an edict halted this year's winter sacrifice at the Southern Suburb.
s0186.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict halted this year's winter sacrifice at the Southern Suburb.

s0187.literal: On guihai day there was an earthquake.
s0187.idiomatic: On guihai day there was an earthquake.

s0188.literal: On jiazi day Hexi County of Lin'an suffered drought through spring and summer without rain; seed would not enter the soil, and residents scattered; officials were ordered to grant relief and have them return to their occupations.
s0188.idiomatic: On jiazi day Hexi County of Lin'an suffered drought through spring and summer without rain; seed would not enter the soil, and residents scattered; officials were ordered to grant relief and have them return to their occupations.

s0189.literal: A multi-storied building was constructed west of Deer Peak Hall at Zhuo Prefecture.
s0189.idiomatic: A multi-storied building was constructed west of Deer Peak Hall at Zhuo Prefecture.

s0190.literal: On bingyin day the Western monk Banji fell ill; he was granted 50,000 strings of notes.
s0190.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Western monk Banji fell ill; he was granted 50,000 strings of notes.

s0191.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingmao day the Directorate of Astronomy requested prohibition of earthworks next year; this was approved.
s0191.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on dingmao day the Directorate of Astronomy requested prohibition of earthworks next year; this was approved.

s0192.literal: On wuchen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; because of national mourning, incense was received without music; temple repair labor was not yet complete, hindering the display of palace suspended music — only ascent hymns were used.
s0192.idiomatic: On wuchen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; because of national mourning, incense was received without music; temple repair labor was not yet complete, hindering the display of palace suspended music — only ascent hymns were used.

s0193.literal: On bingzi day Yajisi sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
s0193.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yajisi sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

s0194.literal: Jiangnan Branch Censorate chief Tuotuo, for requesting leave and leaving office without having received approval, was beaten and demoted to Yunnan.
s0194.idiomatic: Jiangnan Branch Censorate chief Tuotuo, for requesting leave and leaving office without having received approval, was beaten and demoted to Yunnan.

s0195.literal: From gengchen to xinsi day the moon transgressed Well.
s0195.idiomatic: From gengchen to xinsi day the moon transgressed Well.

s0196.literal: On jiashen day an Imperial Spirit Hall for Taizu was built at Xingjiao Temple.
s0196.idiomatic: On jiashen day an Imperial Spirit Hall for Taizu was built at Xingjiao Temple.

s0197.literal: On jichou day Mars transgressed Rampart Wall Formation.
s0197.idiomatic: On jichou day Mars transgressed Rampart Wall Formation.

s0198.literal: Baizhu was made central secretariat right chancellor.
s0198.idiomatic: Baizhu was made central secretariat right chancellor.

s0199.literal: The bandits Tan Gengsheng and others of Nan'en Prefecture surrendered.
s0199.idiomatic: The bandits Tan Gengsheng and others of Nan'en Prefecture surrendered.

s0200.literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0200.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on jiawu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
